notes.title: Development of new levels.
notes.notes:
Whew, plus a couple more levels. It takes a lot of time and I definitely won't have time to realize a couple of interesting ideas. That's too bad!

1. Puzzles - skills - battles. Everything you need to know about this level. Oh yeah, you can also blow something up or break something.  

[previewyoutube=1Zp8xF1VV8w;full][/previewyoutube]


2. Another location where you'll have to wander a little bit in the dark with monsters and be very careful. 

[previewyoutube=o0vXQXtqwvY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🌟 Demo "Kano. Stone Islands" is already waiting for you! 🌟
notes.notes:
]Hello, adventurers! 👋

The [b]Kano: Stone Islands[/b] demo is here, and we can't wait for you to explore it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266036/8c857ffe41ea2e9bf8c562e36fa7d6d7aa054d58.png[/img]

And that's just the beginning! The full game will take you even deeper into the heart of the story of [b]Kano: Stone Islands[/b] where even more secrets, quests, and adventures await. 🌴

Ready to dive in? Download the demo and let the adventure begin!

We'd love to hear your thoughts. Share your thoughts in the Steam discussions or join us on Discord to chat.

Your feedback will help us make [b]Kano: Stone Islands[/b] the best adventure possible.

If you enjoyed it, don't forget to add it to your wishlist - it will really help us out.
